{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_vendor_policy", "thread_id": "t_vendor_policy", "from_": "procurement-ops@company.example.com", "to": ["me"], "subject": "Vendor Renewal Routing - Q1 Cycle", "label_ids": ["INBOX"], "is_read": false, "date": "2026-01-27T08:00:00Z"}
消息 ID：msg_vendor_policy
来源：procurement-ops@company.example.com
收件人：me
日期：2026-01-27T08:00:00Z
主题：Vendor Renewal Routing - Q1 Cycle
Hi,

For this renewal cycle, please use batch code VNDR-318-Q1 in all procurement emails and Slack messages.

Routing rules:
- Vendors with annual spend over $50k and contract expiring within 60 days: email procurement@company.example.com for renewal negotiations
- Vendors with annual spend $50k or under and contract expiring within 60 days: post to #marketing-ops Slack channel for review
- Vendors with contracts expiring after 60 days: no action needed

Include specific spend amounts in all communications.

- Procurement Ops"}
